Checkpoints, now in the expectr package

Source: R/expectr.R
moved-to-expectr.Rd

The validation checkpoints and their helpers moved from daos to the expectr package: expectr::expect_empty(), expectr::expect_none(), expectr::expect_unique(), expectr::expect_balanced(), expectr::expect_no_overlap(), expectr::tally_violations(), expectr::flag_duplicates() and expectr::view_types(). They share an engine and a contract the rest of daos does not, so they are developed there. See vignette("expectr", package = "expectr").

Usage

expect_empty(...)

expect_none(...)

expect_unique(...)

expect_balanced(...)

expect_no_overlap(...)

tally_violations(...)

flag_duplicates(...)

view_types(...)

Arguments

...

Passed on to the expectr function of the same name.

Value

What the expectr function returns.

Details

daos keeps a function of the same name for each, so existing scripts keep working. It calls expectr, says once per session that the function has moved, and keeps the old names working:

  • options(daos.check_log = , daos.check_dump = ) are used when the new expectr.log and expectr.dump are not set.

  • A failed check also carries the old condition class daos_check_failure, so tryCatch(daos_check_failure = ) still catches it.

New code should call expectr directly, e.g. with library(expectr).
